target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one vCPU, VirtIO keyboard and VirtIO sound WAV backend
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=build/vocabulary-current.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-vocabulary
verified: Vocabulary launches from the graphical terminal, accepts an answer and advances the quiz
the app exits with Escape and the terminal evaluates 40+2 as 42 with zstatus failed=0
WAV capture contains active tone windows at approximately 190-200 Hz, consistent with the app's incorrect-answer feedback tone
limits: Automated QEMU/WAV evidence only. The randomized quiz means this run captured the incorrect-answer branch; it does not verify the transient feedback popup or live UTM/Pi sound.
